material.acceptance_criteria: The hp cell of each hero in the expanded team strip equals floor(hp / config.FIX), the same value as the health label of that hero in the selection bar.
material.description: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:318 team_tree prints tostring(h.hp) under the 'hp' header (scenarios/moba/moba_ui.json:112 heroRowHeaders). h.hp is the raw unit_hp stored at panels.lua:194; the native at rust/crates/mod-host/src/piccolo_host.rs:1129-1133 returns sim.hp unscaled. hud_tree (panels.lua:230) and select_tree (panels.lua:483) divide by config.FIX (scenarios/moba/shared/config.lua:3, FIX = 65536), so the strip shows hp times 65536 for the same hero.
material.subject: Team strip shows hero hp in raw Q16.16 units
material.witness: Moot after hud-team-strip-dota-compact (22fc7e2d). Premise absent (codesearch dispatch 1792862300050-5420-8bc535f9932cf07c): team_tree (panels.lua:279-292) prints kill counts and the clock; no hp is printed by the strip. Raw Q16.16 hp appears only in hud_tree (223-231, alive primary via config.FIX) and select_tree (442-473, divided by config.FIX).
material.witness_plan: Live match: expand team rows, select a hero, compare its strip hp cell with the selection health label; mismatch before the fix, equal after.
